description: The arpspoof-style case: a metric learned at 0 then a little activity. After 12 minutes with no DNS, 10.0.0.20 sends 0.9 answered DNS queries/s for 5 minutes. Against a mean of 0 and the 0.2/s DNS floor that scores 4.5 deviations for 5 intervals, but it stays below the DNS min_level (1/s), so the baseline rule does not fire (it does with min_level:dns=0).
extra_rules: alert ip $HOME_NET any <> any any (msg:"floor test"; detect:baseline; min_level:dns=0; sid:9999998; rev:1; severity:low; category:anomaly;)
